_doc: How the 8 specs would be linked to code and tests in nima.
DOCUMENTED: the API calls, the spec-metadata fields (status, ownerId, effort, codebaseFiles, epicId),
statuses draft->approved->in_progress->shipped, PR-to-ticket matching by key in branch/title/body
(then an AI match at confidence >= 0.7), drift matching by card link or file-path segment,
NOT DOCUMENTED / GUESSED: the exact shape codebaseFiles takes (we assume a list of paths), the
ticket key prefix SS-, whether nima stores any spec->symbol or criterion->test link at all.
'symbolsWeWouldWant' and 'tests' below are OUR annotation; nima stores neither per spec.
IMPORTANT: nima's indexer parses 12 languages (TS, JS, Python, Go, Java, Swift, PHP, C#, Rust, C,
C++, Solidity). HTML is not one of them, so the JS inside out/index.html yields no symbols:
for this project every code link is file-level, and all 8 specs point at the same file.
setup: PATCH /documents/{id}/spec-metadata {status: draft, ownerId, effort, codebaseFiles, epicId}
POST /documents/{id}/promote {"columnId": <from the nima team>}  -> card SS-n, status approved
Repository attached at promote time, so the spec is enrolled for drift checks.
testsNote: nima does not run tests and does not read which criterion a test proves. blast_radius on out/index.html would list covering tests only by the path convention above, and since the HTML has no import graph nima can follow, likely none. The tests/*.spec.js files do not exist in this repo; they would have to be written (e.g. Playwright against window.__probe) and run in CI.
